motion_rule: the camera circles the fennec nonstop and races with his sprints; he works his whole body every beat; new shot size every beat; he fills half the frame except the three close-up beats
character: the fennec: desert fennec fox, sandy fur, huge radar ears swivelling to every sound, utterly serious, dreads water; ONE vulture concierge: white jacket, gold buttons, beige bow tie, bulging breast pocket, on a low lifeguard chair at the pool edge
props: ONE pink gift box with a bow
environment: desert resort pool at noon: white bungalows with sharp corners, blue water, striped loungers, palms in tubs
lighting: hard noon sun, high exposure, sparkling caustics, coin glints

audio.pronunciation: ko-ROB-ka o-be-SHCHA-la zo-lo-TY-ye GO-ry. GO-ry, KA-zhet-sya, GDE-to za ug-LOM
audio.pacing: first word at 0.5; 0.5-5.3 one continuous flow, no pause between sentences; after 5.3 not a word, sfx go on
audio.lip_sync: 0.5-5.3 jaw wide open on every syllable

timeline.a: on a striped lounger the fennec yanks the bow off the pink box and flips it upside down: empty
the fennec springs off the lounger and scampers along the hot tiles, shaking the open box upside down at belly level, jaw working, ears drooping
timeline.c: dutch tilt, low at tile level

timeline.a: a jackpot jingle bursts from a bungalow corner, coins spray out; the fennec dashes to it, box in paw, jaw working
timeline.c: low ahead of the running fennec

timeline.a: the fennec skids to a teetering halt on the pool rim, toes curling back from the water, jaw working, ears snapping to the corner
close-up: the fennec lunges into the lens, his muzzle filling the frame, jaw working, one ear swivelling back
the jingle jumps to a farther corner, coins skitter there; the fennec pivots on his hind paws, muzzle to camera, ears tracking it, jaw working, box low at his hip
the fennec snaps to attention, box under one arm, leaps feet-first into the pool; water sheets at the lens
timeline.c: water level, spray at the lens

timeline.a: close-up: only his huge ears stick out of the water like periscopes and dart into the lens, quivering, filling the frame, swivelling to the chair
the vulture hugs his pocket; the soaked fennec scrambles out, sprints over the wet tiles to the chair, box to his chest, ears on the jingling pocket
timeline.c: hurls itself low, runs ahead of him

timeline.a: the fennec rams the vulture's belly box-first at full sprint; the vulture shoots off the chair, skidding on his tail, wings flapping
timeline.c: low beside the fennec, racing along

timeline.a: the fennec races beside the skidding vulture, scooping the box under the bulging pocket; gold coins pour sideways from the pocket into the box
timeline.c: low ahead, coins past the lens

timeline.a: the fennec skids along the pool rim, plants the gold-heaped box, wrings his wet ear out; water whips onto the sputtering vulture
close-up: the fennec dives into the lens, ear dripping, muzzle filling the frame, winks hard; the vulture shakes dry

must_appear: close-ups 3.6 5.9 9.2; ram 7.2; coin stream 7.8; wring 8.4; wink 9.2
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, a second fennec, a third character, duplicate props, coins coming out of the box, closed muzzle while speaking, zoom, top-down view, slow motion, scene change, sand dunes, English speech, accented Russian, any word after the last line, floating objects, vulture upside down, carrying
